text.EN: Damn {slot.killer.name}. {target.name} was my friend, and this will cost you.
text.TL: Bwisit ka, {slot.killer.name}. Kaibigan ko si {target.name}; pagbabayaran mo ito.

text.EN: I saw {target.name} fall. {slot.killer.name} will answer for it.
text.TL: Nakita kong bumagsak si {target.name}. Mananagot si {slot.killer.name}.

text.EN: Hell, {target.name}. What {slot.killer.name} did will not be forgotten.
text.TL: Lintik, {target.name}. Hindi malilimutan ang ginawa ni {slot.killer.name}.

text.EN: I will not let {target.name} be forgotten, and {slot.killer.name} will not get away with it.
text.TL: Hindi ko hahayaang makalimutan si {target.name}, at hindi makakatakas si {slot.killer.name}.

text.EN: {target.name} always had my back. Today, I am coming for {slot.killer.name}.
text.TL: Lagi akong ipinagtatanggol ni {target.name}. Ngayon, ako naman ang hahabol kay {slot.killer.name}.
Putang ina, {slot.killer.name}. Mahalaga sa amin si {target.name}.

text.EN: I hope {slot.killer.name} knows what they took from us when they killed {target.name}.
text.TL: Sana alam ni {slot.killer.name} ang inagaw niya sa amin nang pinatay niya si {target.name}.

text.EN: No more warnings. {slot.killer.name} killed one of ours, {target.name}.
text.TL: Wala nang babala. Pinatay ni {slot.killer.name} ang isa sa amin, si {target.name}.
